about: What tools/build_all.py builds. The loader, our small piece inside the firmware file, is linked by itself from its sources; its binary is the file the installer's builder adds to an owner's firmware file, named under `blob`. The base (base.pack), which every unit with open-field needs, is built from its recipe in packs/. No feature is built here: a feature is a pack in a repository of its own, Faust's four in open-field-packs. Each example is a pack in a folder of its own, with its own recipe, built into out/examples/; the one that changes places of the firmware has a profile of its own. The sizes and hashes of the results are kept in packs/built.json.
